name: handles empty, all-zero, and all-one inputs
test:
assert label_one_blocks('') == []
assert label_one_blocks('0000') == [-1, -1, -1, -1]
assert label_one_blocks('1111') == [0, 0, 0, 0]

name: increments block ids for separated runs
test:
assert label_one_blocks('10101') == [0, -1, 1, -1, 2]
assert label_one_blocks('110011') == [0, 0, -1, -1, 1, 1]
assert label_one_blocks([0, 1, 1, 0, 1]) == [-1, 0, 0, -1, 1]

name: rejects non-binary values
